evidence.finding: Capture.wait_for_result first awaits capture completion future, then advances completion_frames APP updates. Thus60means post-capture updates, never60pre-capture rendered frames.
RenderCapture dispatches saving of selected AOV resource and completes its delegate afterward. Pixel/file completion is a separate concern; retain PNG completion and source-hash checks.
Calling capture_viewport_to_file schedules capture immediately. A later wait_for_result cannot retroactively make that scheduled image a later warmed frame.
n_frames defaults0 and forwards to viewport.usd_context.next_frame_async(viewport,n_frames). Explicit n_frames is the relevant pre-capture rendered-frame wait.
Wait observes NEW_FRAME events filtered by viewport_handle; defaults0/1complete at first matching delivered frame, larger n decrements on matching render events.
Alternative viewport-specific rendered-frame callback counter exists. Neither its source nor next_frame_async guarantees material/shader/PSO convergence.
RTX ready extension emits once on the FIRST NEW_FRAME; it is not a proof that every scene material or PSO compiled, and does not re-establish readiness for each later camera/stage.

Stage file-loading counts and asset/material events are exposed; MDL_PARAM_LOADED concerns some material parameters. These are not a documented global PSO-ready barrier. Renderer accumulation reset is documented for deterministic subsequent frame history, not loading completion.
Frame info exposes resolution, frame_number, swh_frame_number, progression and subframe_count for observability. No material-fully-ready/PSO-complete flag is documented in this inspected contract.
